description: The per-lane UX critic's verdict after the build loop: a screen-by-screen judgement, a ranked list of blockers that must be fixed, and a separate ranked list of polish items that must not.

screens.description: One entry per screen and viewport looked at.

route.description: The route or job screen judged.

viewport.description: The viewport name or width the screenshot was taken at.

verdict.description: OK if a first-time user would succeed here without confusion; FIX otherwise.

what.description: What was seen and why it earned this verdict.

fix.description: The concrete fix, or an empty string when verdict is OK.

blockers.description: Ranked, most-severe first. Would confuse a first-time user or break the target path; the blocker fixer must address every one.

id.description: A short stable identifier for this blocker.

file.description: The file the fix belongs in.

polish.description: Nice-to-have improvements that are not blockers and must stay untouched by the blocker fixer.
